lines.x: Kenya's Public Service Superannuation Scheme declared a 17.99% interest rate for members as total assets grew 41.6% to KSh343.81 billion.
Kenya is readying crude oil drilling in South Lokichar in Turkana as it aims to join Uganda and South Sudan as an East African petroleum exporter.
Gulf Energy confirmed its first-phase oil production schedule remains on track in Kenya.
A US-led consortium was chosen to develop Kenya's Mrima Hill rare-earth and niobium project, while a Chinese joint venture secured contracts for two separate mineral projects.
